meta.title: Produce and publish an HGM SOP
meta.lead: How a process becomes an approved, on-brand SOP. If you remember one thing: never invent a detail to fill a gap — flag it and ask the process owner.
meta.frequency: On request, or when a process changes

items.d: Produces a consistent, approved SOP that lets any team member perform a task without asking the usual owner.
All internal HGM processes documented as SOPs, across web, content, ops, finance, security, and client work.
Client deliverables, one-off Asana task notes, and training material — each has its own format.
Edit permission on the HGM SOP Studio Claude Project.
Notes, a Fireflies transcript, a Scribe export, or a booked call with the process owner.
One of WEB, CON, OPS, FIN, SEC, CLI — this sets the SOP ID.
The next sequential number for that department, from the SOP index.

items.t: Open a new chat in the project
items.d: State the process name and the department code in your first message.

items.t: Attach all source material at once
items.d: Paste notes or attach the transcript or export.
items.expect: One batched round of clarifying questions, not a draft.

items.d: Where you do not know, write unknown. The gap gets flagged instead of invented.
Check it against the source material line by line.
items.expect: Every step is one imperative action, with no vague frequency or location wording.

items.d: Supply the missing detail or confirm it with the process owner.
Shoot the described view at 2× resolution and name each file to match its number.

items.expect: A matched set: the .md source, the .json content file, and the styled .pdf.

items.d: The run must report that brand fonts loaded and the Quality Gate passed.
Save to the SOP folder in Google Drive using the naming convention.
Record ID, title, owner, version, and next review date.
Send the PDF to the Operations Manager and log the outcome in the index.

blocks.t: Font fallback means the PDF is not brand compliant
blocks.text: If the build reports a font fallback, the document is set in a substitute face rather than Inter. Fix the font path and rerun before routing for approval — do not send it.

rows: Confirm the light wordmark is attached to the project
Confirm the renderer was run, not rewritten
Deliver with open flags marked — do not guess

items: HGM-Doc-Design-System.md — the document design language and component vocabulary
SOP index — the register of every SOP and its review date

blocks.quote: "An SOP is finished when a new hire can run it without asking a single question — not when it looks complete."
